sources: https://coh.bookmysites.com/reservations/checkout-availability (the city's BookMySites booking engine; site types and default prices from its /api/reservations/checkout-availability answer, read in a browser 2026-10-22)

values.note: City of Hancock booking engine, read 2026-10-22: '30 AMP Standard' sites $28 a night ('ideal for units 30 feet or less'); 30-amp with water, 50-amp with water, 50-amp large RV and the 30/50-amp waterfront sites $35; tent sites $18. The city's own page lists the same rates 'as of March 15, 2023'. One rate for everyone (no resident/non-resident split posted). A 50% deposit is charged at booking; there is a fee to use the boat launch for non-campers only.

fees.source: https://coh.bookmysites.com/reservations/checkout-availability (site types with default_price/per_night: 30 AMP Standard 28, 30 AMP with Water Service 35, 50 Amp With Water 35, 50 Amp Large RV Space 35, 50 Amp Waterfront 35, 30 Amp Waterfront 35, Tent Sites 18), read 2026-10-22 + https://www.cityofhancock.com/recreation-beach-campground.php ('Current Rates (as of March 15, 2023)' ... 'Remaining regular sites... $28/per day'), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://coh.bookmysites.com/reservations/checkout-availability (site types '50 Amp With Water' (site 4, amenities '50 Amp Service', 'Water Hookup'), '30 AMP with Water Service' (12 sites), 50-amp large RV and waterfront sites) + https://www.cityofhancock.com/recreation-beach-campground.php ('50 amp sites - #4, 48, 52, 53, 54, 55, 56, 57 & 58'; 'Water service sites - #1, 3, 4, 6, 8, 9, 18, 23, 24, 25, 41, and 46'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 58 RV sites with electric and 14 tent sites. The booking engine calls the 30-amp standard sites 'ideal for units 30 feet or less' and tags the 50-amp large and waterfront sites 'Over 35 ft.'; no maximum rig length is stated.

sites.source: https://www.cityofhancock.com/recreation-beach-campground.php ('There are 72 campsites to choose from - 58 for recreational vehicles (with electric power) and 14 tent sites') + https://coh.bookmysites.com/reservations/checkout-availability (site-type descriptions and amenities), read 2026-10-22. The stored 25-ft maximum (note prose) is contradicted and cleared.

facilities.source: https://www.cityofhancock.com/recreation-beach-campground.php ('The campground contains restrooms, shower facilities and a laundry'; 'Free Wi-Fi Internet Access Available') + booking engine amenities ('Dump Station'), read 2026-10-22

season.source: https://www.cityofhancock.com/recreation-beach-campground.php ('The Facility is open to the public from May 15 to October 15'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Online through the city's BookMySites system (50% deposit at booking) or by calling 906-482-7413. Reservations for the coming season open at 9:00 AM on the first business day after January 1. Cancel more than 7 days out for a full refund of the deposit; no refunds for early departure. The engine caps stays at 14-15 nights by site type.

booking.source: https://www.cityofhancock.com/recreation-beach-campground.php ('Online Reservations - Campground & Pavilion'; 'To secure your reservation, a 50% deposit'; 'Reservations for the upcoming season will open at 9:00 AM on the first business day following January 1st each year'; cancellation policy) + https://coh.bookmysites.com/reservations/checkout-availability (stay_limit 14/15), read 2026-10-22

note: City of Hancock Recreation Area on Portage Lake, ~1 mi west of downtown on M-203 (2000 Jasberg St), with a 300-ft sand swimming beach, a boat ramp and a pavilion; the sites sit in a wooded stand of conifers and hardwoods. --Claude
summary: City page + its BookMySites engine (read 2026-10-22): 72 sites (58 electric RV, 14 tent), $28 30-amp standard / $35 water, 50-amp and waterfront sites / $18 tent, no resident split; 50 A max, water at 13 sites; showers, laundry, free Wi-Fi, dump; open May 15 - Oct 15; online booking with 50% deposit; phone 906-482-7413 matches. Changed: max_rig_ft 25 -> cleared (the engine calls standard sites 'ideal for units 30 feet or less' and its 50-amp sites 'Over 35 ft.'), added water hookups, wifi, dump, booking url/note. Note cleaned of the counts, hookups, season, prices and booking text the fields hold, and of the wrong 25-ft limit.
flags: Waterfront re-audit lead: the city's booking engine sells '50 Amp Waterfront' (sites 52-55: 'Breathtaking view of the water right from your own camper') and '30 Amp Waterfront' (sites 47, 49-51) site types, and the city page lists 'Waterfront Sites #47, 49, 50 and 51'; the entry is 'not waterfront'.
